Name: Junimo digspot
Author: aefnnsty
Description:
This mod will turn the artifact spots (the little worms) into animated junimos. 

I always loved this idea, but all the mod which do that currently are only for XNB, and they don't work on mobile. So a made this mod for myself and decided to post.

With 3 different actions (waving, jumping and dancing)

And 5 color (purple, blue, green, red, yellow)

You can choose the action and color in the config file or the generic configuration menu in game.

Coming next: figure out how to make it random.
Add more colors
Add more actions

Fully compatible with mobile (after all I made it on a phone lol) should work with no problems on PC, I have no way of testing. 

Please let me know it any problems occurs. 

I will try to fix it, but this is my first mod and I don't know a lot.
